title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-300's (CP-1) > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell UDXLII); Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 24-bit/96KHz) > Soundforge 9.0 (edits); Recorded on the floor FOB by Bob Morris

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a full show with consistently good versions, though some feel the band was in a playful, tentative mood.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a complete performance that many fans describe as solid from start to finish, with clear and pleasant audience‑sourced sound. While one reviewer raves about every song being “all good,” another notes a slightly silly vibe and tentative renditions of newer material, especially pointing out Bob Weir’s tongue‑in‑cheek delivery.

ai_rating.rationale: High rating from one detailed 5‑star review and a moderate 3‑star comment yields an overall strong score; limited number of reviews lowers confidence to medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners praise the clear, pleasant audience capture (“Sweet AUD”) with no major drop‑outs or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally praised as a great full‑show experience, though some newer songs felt tentative and the overall mood was described as a bit silly.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir sounds playful, almost making fun of himself, with tentative vocal delivery on new material.
